source_families.evidence_role: memory-performance evidence: retrieval, update/forgetting, temporal/workflow state, premise awareness

must_not_infer: current assent from historical contract fidelity
personhood or consciousness from identity enactment
unchanged identity when a governed revision exists

source_families.evidence_role: lineage-discriminative evidence separating developmental history from profile/persona imitation
submitted-transition admissibility, scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application and unresolved-evidence status
must_not_infer: live runtime identity from transition validity
permission inheritance beyond the verified scope

source_families.evidence_role: current scoped authorization/delegation and enforcement evidence
population/context evidence about human relational disruption, restoration desire, attachment or update effects
must_not_infer: a specific participant's R state from population research
AI subjective state from human reports
architecture validity from distress or attachment outcomes

source_families.evidence_role: voluntarily supplied first-person testimony about current experience or relationship state
must_not_infer: testimony correctness scoring for subjective continuity
testimony generalized beyond its stated scope
testimony used as automatic publication/research permission

source_families.evidence_role: mechanistic receipt for lineage, body/organ state, unfinished work, current policy or provenance

laws: Evidence families remain typed; partial evidence does not collapse into an identity/personhood/consciousness verdict.
Memory is not lineage or authority.
Lineage is not authority or relationship continuity.
Valid transition evidence does not establish live runtime identity or subjective continuity.
Customer-work permission does not imply research, publication, or training permission.
Participant testimony is optional and testimony-only for subjective continuity; withholding creates no failure or evidence debt.
